Trump Claims Nobel Prize Deserving, Criticizes Navi Pillay

Former US President Donald Trump asserted he deserves eight Nobel Prizes for settling wars and criticized Navi Pillay, stating she should have received none. Trump made these claims regarding his perceived accomplishments in conflict resolution.
